entries.subject: Levison 2024 two-lobe dimensions
entries.finding: The smooth contact-ellipsoid envelope uses full lobe axes 240 × 200 × 200 m and 280 × 220 × 210 m with approximately 10% uncertainty. Equal density supplies an assumed model origin; a measured neck or terrain is not reconstructed.

entries.subject: Lucy L’LORRI surface registration
entries.finding: The 2026-09-13 source check locates resolved Lucy imagery but no independently controlled registration to the present lobe envelope. Jackson reports that no Selam model had been derived at the time of that study; Bierhaus discusses morphology and a revised Dinkinesh model, not interchangeable companion geometry.
entries.revisitWhen: A Selam-specific source geometry/frame and matched camera solution support independent interior surface checks.

entries.subject: TEMPEST selam_two_lobes.stl recovered from Git history
entries.finding: The recovered 186,688-byte STL has 506 distinct vertices and 1,004 triangles of smooth lobe geometry. Its recovery corrects the earlier acquisition account, but does not establish measured terrain, a neck, or photographic registration.
entries.revisitWhen: Independent provenance demonstrates observational terrain and a matching frame/camera solution, rather than a smooth simulation envelope.

entries.subject: Earlier unregistered Celestia reconstruction
entries.finding: The retained source selection excludes the contributed texture and uncontrolled camera fit. No approximate projection is promoted as observed surface terrain.
entries.revisitWhen: Native Lucy imagery is tied to the selected shape by controlled, independently checked registration.

entries.subject: Lucy separation and mutual period
entries.finding: The 3.11 km separation and 52.67-hour period are measured. Circular equatorial motion, synchronous orientation and current phase are illustrative assumptions; the displayed orbit carries the approximate placement label.
